description: This file declares the QemuManager class, which manages QEMU virtual machine instances within the cuttlefish project. It includes class declarations, method prototypes, and necessary includes, serving as an interface for VM management related operations.

classes.name: QemuManager
classes.description: A class that manages QEMU virtual machines, providing methods to configure graphics, boot devices, and start commands.

methods.name: std::string name()
methods.description: Returns the string identifier for this VM manager, 'qemu_cli'.

methods.name: QemuManager
methods.description: Constructor accepting an architecture parameter to initialize the VM manager.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks whether the host supports the required QEMU CLI features.

methods.name: ConfigureGraphics
methods.description: Configures graphics settings for the VM based on the provided instance configuration.

methods.name: ConfigureBootDevices
methods.description: Configures boot devices for the VM based on the provided instance configuration.

methods.name: StartCommands
methods.description: Generates the command sequence to start the QEMU VM with given configurations and dependencies.
